findings.evidence: Digest at dbff837f is a cut list: 'removed units (306, showing 40)'. All 40 shown items are explained by record.md rows (checked against sections.json) or are present in references/schema-fundamentals.md, migrations.md or the template. The other 266 units could not be checked.
findings.fix: Regenerate the dbff837f digest without the cut so every removed unit can be checked against docs/audit/recovery/database-schema-designer/record.md and sections.json. Add a row for any unit no section-level row covers.

findings.evidence: Knowledge delta is high: the defaults, workflow and gotchas are almost all expert, engine-specific content. The 1-point gap is a judgment call, not a defect (the only deduction is the D1-1 cut-list finding).
findings.fix: No content change needed. Keep the current Defaults, Workflow and Gotchas as they are.

findings.evidence: Workflow step 4 'Check before answering' puts the sketch check, the routing to schema-fundamentals.md, the routing to the review checklist and the full report-format rules into one bullet of about 150 words. The checkpoint gets lost.
findings.fix: Split step 4 into labeled sub-bullets: (a) sketch self-check, (b) when to read references/schema-fundamentals.md, (c) review or sign-off with references/schema-design-checklist.md and its report format, (d) MongoDB variant. Keep every rule, only restructure.

findings.evidence: 'MongoDB documents stop at 16 MiB': this vendor limit has no source URL or date checked, and no instruction reads it live. The upstream registry already lists https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/limits/.
findings.fix: Add the source after the limit: '(https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/limits/, checked <date>)'.

findings.evidence: 'add the FK with ALGORITHM=COPY ... INPLACE works only with foreign_key_checks = 0': this MySQL online-DDL behavior has no source URL or date checked.
findings.fix: Cite https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/innodb-online-ddl-operations.html (foreign key operations) with the date checked, or tell the reader to confirm on that page for their server version.

findings.evidence: The MySQL 'MODIFY phone VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, ALGORITHM=INPLACE, LOCK=NONE' step does not say that in-place NOT NULL needs STRICT_TRANS_TABLES or STRICT_ALL_TABLES. On a non-strict sql_mode the branch fails without a fallback.
findings.fix: Add: 'INPLACE NOT NULL requires a strict sql_mode (STRICT_TRANS_TABLES or STRICT_ALL_TABLES); check SELECT @@sql_mode first, and read the Online DDL Operations page for your version.'
